models.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.description: Smallest model of DeepSeek's new architecture family with native multimodal visual understanding, served under the deepseek-flash API name

pricing.note: Peak-hour rate; off-peak (weekends and outside 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays) is 50% lower

changelog.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash released with a 1M context window, up to 384K output, native vision, and support for both thinking and non-thinking modes; call it via the deepseek-flash model name
API pricing reduced to $0.30 per 1M input tokens and $1.20 per 1M output tokens at peak hours ($0.15 and $0.60 off-peak); cache hits $0.006 per 1M tokens

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models.description: Latest DeepSeek V3 iteration with improved MoE architecture

changelog.description: DeepSeek V3.2 released with improved reasoning and efficiency
The deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner API names were fully retired on July 24, 2026; use deepseek-flash or deepseek-v4-pro instead

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.description: DeepSeek's next-generation general-purpose model with stronger reasoning, coding, and tool use

pricing.note: Peak-hour rate; off-peak (weekends and outside 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC weekdays) is 50% lower

changelog.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro released for API access with stronger reasoning, coding, and tool-use performance
Promotional API pricing listed at $0.50 per 1M input tokens and $1.50 per 1M output tokens
DeepSeek V4 Pro reached general availability as build 0813 with 1.6T total / 49B active parameters, 1M context, up to 384K output, low/high/max thinking effort, and native Responses API support
Peak/off-peak API pricing introduced from August 16, 2026: $1.32 per 1M input tokens and $3.96 per 1M output tokens at peak hours, half that off-peak
Planned routing of V4 Pro requests to V4.1 Flash after September 14, 2026 was reversed; V4 Pro remains on the API with unchanged billing

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.description: Lower-latency DeepSeek V4 model for high-throughput chat, coding, and agent workloads; retired in favor of V4.1 Flash

changelog.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash released alongside V4 Pro for faster and lower-cost API workloads
Pricing set at $0.14 per 1M input tokens and $0.28 per 1M output tokens
DeepSeek scheduled deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner compatibility aliases for retirement on June 15, 2026
Legacy deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner API names, which had pointed to V4 Flash, were discontinued on July 24, 2026
DeepSeek V4 Flash official release (build 0731) entered public beta with open weights under the MIT license, re-post-trained on the same architecture with much stronger agent benchmarks
Experimental multimodal variant DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp released on the API
V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp retired on September 10, 2026; the deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp names are temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash
